toegepas.blok: Een straat en die hele wêreld
toegepas.na: om op die blad te pas
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daarop' points back past a whole sentence to 'bladsye'; naming the page is clearer and matches the next sentence's 'blad'.
toegepas.fout: 'daarop' sits directly after 'een straat' and can be read on first pass as fitting onto the street rather than onto the page.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the page removes the stumble without changing what has to fit where, and the protected 'op bladsye van dieselfde grootte' in the previous sentence is untouched.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoeveel plek een kilometer op die blad kry
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daar is' floats free; 'Daarop' ties the room for small things to the large-scale map just named.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Daar is plek vir' already reads naturally after the map has just been named, and 'Daarop' would repeat the 'daarop' two sentences earlier, which there refers to the page.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die twee woorde vergelyk kaarte met mekaar
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Not wrong, but 'Die twee woorde' has no nearby antecedent: the last place the two terms are named as a pair is the previous block ('Die twee name'), so a learner may not know which two words are meant.
